n01.roman: PlayStation aur Xbox store ki listing ke hisaab se, GTA 6 har desh mein wahan ki aadhi raat ko khulega.

n02.roman: Matlab India mein: 19 November, raat 12 baje. Yaani 18 ki raat, jaise hi 12 bajein!

n03.roman: Twist: sabse pehle New Zealand! India ke time se 18 November, shaam saadhe chaar baje. Humse saadhe saat ghante pehle!

n04.roman: Aur America ke Eastern time waale? India ke time se 19 November, subah saadhe das baje. Hum unse das ghante se zyaada aage!

n05.roman: Rockstar ke mutabik, digital pre-load 10 November se khula hai, 212 GB tak. To raat 12 se pehle download kar lo!
